item.title: Version 4.7.3
item.description:
Notch So Good 4.7.3

  • "Answer in terminal" no longer leaves the next waiting card stuck
  • Approvals stay on for Claude Code installed with nvm, volta or bun
  • "Only when blocked" sound is remembered after a restart
  • Clicking an option after typing sends just that option
  • A signed-out Claude account clears its old usage numbers
  • Long questions keep their answers

Install this one by hand: run brew upgrade notch-so-good, or download it from the release page. From 4.7.3 on, updates install themselves.
